test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 05
subject: general
question: According to the NITI Aayog policy report titled 'School Education System in India', how many comprehensive recommendations does the detailed policy roadmap comprise?
solution:
The correct answer is __**13**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **NITI Aayog** released a policy report titled ‘**School Education System in India: Temporal Analysis and Policy Roadmap for Quality Enhancement**’ on **May 6, 2026**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The detailed policy roadmap provided in the report comprises **13 comprehensive recommendations**.
 
• These recommendations are structurally divided into **8 systemic recommendations** and **5 academic recommendations**.
 
• **Systemic recommendations** involve reforming school structure, governance reform, expanding digital learning, and promoting equity.
 
• **Academic recommendations** focus on transforming pedagogy, integrating AI, holistic education, and reimagining vocational training.
 
• Therefore, **13** is the exact number of comprehensive recommendations given in the policy roadmap.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• While **8** is mentioned in the text, it specifically refers to the subset of **systemic recommendations**.
 
• The number **11** refers to the major challenges identified across systemic and academic areas.
 
• The number **33** denotes the implementation pathways provided for the recommendations, structured across short, medium, and long-term horizons.
 
• The report draws on data from various secondary sources, including **UDISE+ 2024-25**, **PARAKH Rashtriya Sarvekshan 2024**, and **ASER 2024**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• India's school education system spans **14.71 lakh schools**, serving over **24.69 crore students**, making it the **largest system in the world**.
 
• The report provides over **125 measurable Performance Success Indicators** to track the progress of the stated recommendations.
